title: bee-gather declares the read job and every agent description names the door
action:
Per D4: in templates.rs change the row `("bee-gather", &["generation"]),` (rg hit templates.rs:386) to `("bee-gather", &["read", "generation"])` — the SAME list grrs-1 gave `tier_role_list("read")` (read first, then generation; never extraction), so the opencode render pin (`resolve_opencode_agent_model` in agents.rs), the Claude sync record's `rendered_from`, and `validate_agent_files_drift` (status_full/store.rs) all walk it through the shared resolver with no further edit; update the comment above the table ("Two agents share the generation role…") to say bee-gather asks for the read job first. Add/adjust tests in agents.rs and status_full/tests.rs: an opencode host with `models.opencode.read` set pins that model into `.opencode/agent/bee-gather.md`; with no `read` key it pins `generation`'s exactly as today; the Claude plan still renders every known agent unconditionally under a herding-shaped `read` slot (D6 — extend `plan_renders_unconditionally_and_never_removes_a_known_agent`).

In `packages/bee/agents/bee-gather.md.tmpl` line 7, replace `You run at the **generation** tier` with wording that says the read role, falling through to generation when the host configures no `read` — one sentence, no tier word.

Per D5: in all four templates the `description:` line (rg hits `^description:` at line 3 of bee-gather, bee-extract, bee-build, bee-review .md.tmpl) OPENS with one plain sentence naming the door — e.g. `Reached only through \`bee dispatch prepare\` (it may return a pane command instead of this type) — never name this type by hand.` — then the existing text. Keep each description on ONE line (the frontmatter reader is single-line). AGENT_DESCRIPTIONS-style tables in guard.rs are keyed on agent and quote no description bytes, so nothing else restates them — confirm with `rg -n "I/O-offload gather worker" packages/` before and after.

Then run the regen chain: `.bee/bin/bee dev regen` (renders skill trees, re-onboards this checkout with --apply, rewrites the release manifest). Commit everything it touched. `cargo test ... agents_block_render_parity onboard status_full` must be green; `bee dev release-manifest --check` clean; `git status` shows no unstaged regen output.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml onboard status_full agents_block_render_parity && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check
